paragraphs.source_en: Toyotomi Hideyoshi's funeral was duly concluded in the second month of Keichō 4. As the former kampaku, Hideyoshi was posthumously granted the titles “Hōkoku Daimyōjin” and “Kokutai Yūshō-in-den Unzan Shunryū”; all judgment of his merits and faults had departed with him. The world welcomed another spring day radiant with cherry blossoms.

units.source_en: Toyotomi Hideyoshi's funeral was duly concluded in the second month of Keichō 4.
units.source_zh: 丰臣秀吉的葬礼于庆长四年二月圆满结束。

units.source_en: As the former kampaku, Hideyoshi was posthumously granted the titles “Hōkoku Daimyōjin” and “Kokutai Yūshō-in-den Unzan Shunryū”; all judgment of his merits and faults had departed with him.
units.source_zh: 作为前关白，秀吉获赐“丰国大明神、国泰佑松院殿云山俊龙”之号，功过是非均已随他而去。

units.source_en: The world welcomed another spring day radiant with cherry blossoms.
units.source_zh: 人世间又迎来一个樱花烂漫的春日。

paragraphs.source_zh: 丰臣秀吉的葬礼于庆长四年二月圆满结束。作为前关白，秀吉获赐“丰国大明神、国泰佑松院殿云山俊龙”之号，功过是非均已随他而去。人世间又迎来一个樱花烂漫的春日。

paragraphs.source_en: Seven years of warfare had ended, and only after Maeda Toshiie and Tokugawa Ieyasu made peace could the funeral proceed without incident. Thus, that spring, people could leisurely admire the blossoms and pray for peace throughout the realm. But had the troubles and grudges of the countless souls in this mortal world truly subsided?

units.source_en: Seven years of warfare had ended, and only after Maeda Toshiie and Tokugawa Ieyasu made peace could the funeral proceed without incident.
units.source_zh: 历经七年的战事结束了，前田利家和德川家康握手言和，葬礼方得以顺利举行。

units.source_en: Thus, that spring, people could leisurely admire the blossoms and pray for peace throughout the realm.
units.source_zh: 故，在这个春天，人们都可悠然赏花，祈祷天下太平。

units.source_en: But had the troubles and grudges of the countless souls in this mortal world truly subsided?
units.source_zh: 可尘世间芸芸众生的烦恼和恩怨，果真就此平息了吗？

paragraphs.source_zh: 历经七年的战事结束了，前田利家和德川家康握手言和，葬礼方得以顺利举行。故，在这个春天，人们都可悠然赏花，祈祷天下太平。可尘世间芸芸众生的烦恼和恩怨，果真就此平息了吗？

paragraphs.source_en: The residence of Konishi Settsu-no-kami Yukinaga stood on open high ground on the left bank of the Yodo River, flanked by the residences of Ishida Mitsunari and Maeda Toshiie. That day, two blossom-viewing boats belonging to the Yodoya family lay moored at the riverbank.

units.source_en: The residence of Konishi Settsu-no-kami Yukinaga stood on open high ground on the left bank of the Yodo River, flanked by the residences of Ishida Mitsunari and Maeda Toshiie.

paragraphs.source_en: Ostensibly, Konishi Yukinaga had invited wealthy merchants to view the blossoms, but those who stepped from the boats were no merchants. First came the two senior elders, Mōri Terumoto and Ukita Hideie, followed by the three commissioners Natsuka Masaie, Mashita Nagamori, and Maeda Gen'i, all in disguise. Led by Konishi retainers Nanjō Gentaku and Konishi Hayato, the five men vanished straight into the depths of the sprawling residence.

paragraphs.source_en: It was the eleventh day of the third month, just after the Hour of the Serpent. Deep within the Konishi residence, the casually dressed master, Konishi Yukinaga, and Ishida Mitsunari, who had arrived earlier, respectfully welcomed the five men. A mild breeze carried warmth, and pale clouds drifted across the sky; against the bright spring light, the more than twenty double-flowered cherry trees planted beside the riverside wall looked more splendid than ever.
